title: Privileged startup trusts inherited environment before hardening
recommendation: Sanitize immediately after elevation, resolve Windows system paths through WinAPI, rebuild a minimal privileged environment, derive canonical restart argv from verified executables, and attest any external watchdog rather than trusting environment flags.

title: First fleet migration accepts an inherited attacker-selected operator key
recommendation: Migrate only protected-provenance credentials or an explicit post-elevation import, purge inherited fleet key material, and atomically generate and verify a fresh protected key when no protected state exists.

title: Loopback HTTP can be proxied off-host and is vulnerable to resolution TOCTOU
recommendation: Disable proxies for local-service transport with ProxyHandler({}), prefer literal loopback or pin the validated numeric peer, and support enterprise proxies only through explicit protected policy.

title: Protected credentials are republished globally and inherited by every child
recommendation: Use a narrow just-in-time credential broker instead of os.environ and build minimal allowlisted child environments that exclude API keys, tokens, passwords, mail credentials, webhooks, and proxy controls.

title: Fleet credentials never expire and principal expiry rolls forward on restart
recommendation: Persist fixed credential issue/expiry/revocation and rotation state, bind principal validity to that fixed expiry, and add audited operator/device rotation and re-enrollment.
